name: Quality of Life
author: OpenDejenol
description: Small conveniences for the town, the Store, the Bank and the party windows.

choices.label: Town gold
choices.description: Where the party's gold is kept in town, and who covers a charge the payer is short of.
optionDescriptions: As the game: nothing automatic. Sales pay the seller's hand; a charge takes the payer's hand, then bank.
Arriving and selling put gold in each one's own account; a shortfall comes from the others' accounts, in party order.
Arriving and selling put the party's gold in the leader's account; it covers a shortfall after the payer's own bank.

settings.label: Unlocked Store alignment choice
settings.description: Another item can be picked while Select Alignment is up in the Store.

settings.label: Toolbar tooltips
settings.description: Each toolbar button names its function and key under the mouse.

settings.label: Next column (XP to next level)
settings.description: A Next column in Party Information with the experience still needed.

settings.label: HP/SP bars
settings.description: Hit point and spell point bars in Party Information.

settings.label: XP bar
settings.description: A bar to the next level, then to the pin, behind the Next column's figure.

settings.label: Quest marks
settings.description: A mark in the Next column for a guild quest, a tick once it is done.

settings.label: Unidentified-item marks
settings.description: A coloured ? after an item not yet fully identified.

settings.label: Slot and Worn columns
settings.description: Slot and Worn columns in the Store's Buy list show where each item is worn.

settings.label: Sortable column headings
settings.description: The Store's Item and Slot headings sort the Buy list when clicked.

settings.label: Note what a sale stocks
settings.description: Messages says when an item you sell goes onto the Store's shelf.

settings.label: Color-coded combat messages
settings.description: Colours combat lines in the Messages window by kind.

groups.label: General
groups.description: The Store's unlocked alignment choice and the toolbar's tooltips.

groups.label: Town gold
groups.description: In town, gold kept in the bank for you and charges covered from it. The dungeon's gold is always split evenly.

groups.label: Enhanced character UI
groups.description: Adds a Next column, HP/SP and XP bars, quest marks and unidentified-item marks.

groups.label: Enhanced store UI
groups.description: Adds Slot and Worn columns, sortable headings, and a note of what a sale stocks to the Store.

groups.label: Color-coded combat messages
groups.description: Colours combat lines in the Messages window by kind.
